sources.accessObserved: Sample articles readable; automated retrieval can fail intermittently
sources.notes: Follow credits to the original reporting. A new publication date does not make older metrics current.

sources.name: Startup Pedia Startup Stories
sources.bestFor: Young founders, women founders, small businesses and emerging SaaS
sources.accessObserved: Sample articles readable without a paid login
sources.notes: Prefer attributable founder interviews. Distinguish original reporting from rewritten older coverage.

sources.name: Blume Commentary
sources.bestFor: Founding decisions, pivots, enterprise sales, pricing and Indian market theses
sources.accessObserved: Public articles readable; linked full reports may have separate access requirements
sources.notes: Publishes periodically. Identify investor and portfolio-company perspectives; do not treat them as independent confirmation.

sources.name: Accel News
sources.bestFor: Early portfolio discovery, founder journeys and investor recollections
sources.accessObserved: Sample investor account readable without a paid login
sources.notes: Filter global coverage for relevant Indian founders and disclose the investor relationship.

sources.name: Entrackr News
sources.bestFor: Funding, IPOs, acquisitions, appointments and startup developments
sources.accessObserved: Sample article body readable; login prompts present
sources.notes: Use for discovery, then verify the underlying announcement or filing and explain a commercial mechanism.

sources.name: Entrackr Fintrackr
sources.bestFor: Revenue mix, expenses, profitability and capital efficiency
sources.accessObserved: Sample article body readable without a paid login
sources.notes: Check Entrackr's homepage too. Preserve fiscal periods and distinguish operating revenue, total income, profit and cash flow. Attribute filings indirectly if not personally inspected.

sources.name: Inc42
sources.bestFor: Business-model comparisons, monetization, category competition and startup news
sources.accessObserved: Metered or subscription access; some article text accessible
sources.notes: Do not rely on inaccessible article bodies or bypass access restrictions. Identify BrandLabs or sponsored content.

sources.name: Economic Times Startups
sources.bestFor: Management interviews, ecosystem developments, markets and policy context
sources.accessObserved: Mixed access; some articles expose only a synopsis
sources.notes: Use accessible full articles and primary documents. A synopsis is not enough evidence for a detailed insight.

sources.name: Mint Companies
sources.bestFor: Distribution, retail economics, corporate strategy, manufacturing and results
sources.accessObserved: Mixed public and Premium access; sampled article readable
sources.notes: Trace stories that credit other publishers back to the original source.

sources.name: Peak XV Insights
sources.bestFor: Operating systems, organization design, product and scaling case studies
sources.accessObserved: Sample article readable without a paid login
sources.notes: Evergreen supplement rather than a daily breaking-news feed. Preserve the essay date and investor perspective.

sources.name: Startup India Showcase
sources.bestFor: Additional startup candidates, sectors, company websites and founder identities
sources.accessObserved: Public introduction accessible; profile tools may require login
sources.notes: The portal says profile information is self-declared. Use for discovery, not independent financial verification.

sources.name: NSE Corporate Announcements
sources.bestFor: Listed-company announcements, results, transactions and management changes
sources.accessObserved: Public index accessible; individual document retrieval may vary
sources.notes: Read the specific dated filing and preserve its units and reporting period.

sources.name: SEBI Public Issue Filings
sources.bestFor: IPO prospectuses, company history, financials and issue structure
sources.notes: Use the latest relevant document. Distinguish DRHP, RHP, approval and listing; separate fresh issue from offer for sale.

primaryVerificationPolicy.funding: Company and lead-investor announcements; distinguish proposed, allotted and closed rounds and equity from debt or secondary sales
primaryVerificationPolicy.companyFinancials: Company annual reports, investor relations and accessible filed financial statements; retain fiscal periods and source attribution
primaryVerificationPolicy.policy: The regulator's actual dated circular or order and its effective date
primaryVerificationPolicy.founderBackground: Founder or company biography and attributable interviews; unknown birth details or quotations must remain omitted
primaryVerificationPolicy.independence: Two outlets repeating the same announcement are one evidence chain

dailySelectionPolicy.founder: Choose a founder not already profiled. Use a specific origin or decision angle and re-check current company status and any metrics on the day of drafting.
dailySelectionPolicy.businessInsight: Prefer developments from the previous 24-48 hours; extend across weekends or use a clearly dated evergreen case when needed. Explain the business mechanism and one practical implication.
dailySelectionPolicy.freshness: Record both article publication date and underlying event or financial-period date. Do not present old metrics as current.
dailySelectionPolicy.novelty: Check founder aliases, company, event and angle across all four editorial data files, saved social drafts and prior daily chat outputs.
dailySelectionPolicy.writing: Original English prose; no copying article bodies or inventing quotations, private interviews or exclusive reporting.
dailySelectionPolicy.sources: Cite the specific supporting articles and primary documents, not just these discovery index pages.
dailySelectionPolicy.access: If a source is unavailable or paywalled, switch to an accessible source and report any unresolved limitation.
